envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: the operator ruled memory a palimpsest to be removed, and with it the plugin kernel it alone used, heartbeat (routed, bound by nothing) and per-capability session scope

payload.gloss: a programmatic thing the runtime ships and the CLI routes by its name to that capability's own verb surface, whose verbs declare their verb flags: `eventTap`, `design`, `plan` and `note`, each built into the runtime. The set is known when the runtime is built: the runtime discovers no capability providers and loads no plugins, and no capability needs a session.
